explanation: Build prerequisite-to-course edges and indegrees. Repeatedly remove a zero-indegree course and release its dependents. All courses are removable exactly when no directed cycle remains.
timeComplexity: O(V + E) time for V courses and E prerequisite pairs.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 JavaScript algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
